title: Nested model selection and shrinkage of advanced predictions for dementia triage
status: Exploratory extension informed by v1 and v2; fixed before v3 outcomes; not a public preregistration
population: Original development participants only; never evaluate or train on any v1/v2 holdout in this extension
selection_metric: Mean cross-validated Brier; fixed candidate order breaks ties; selection repeated inside every gate training fold
original_advanced_candidates: Same four calibrated logistic candidates plus calibrated RBF SVC C in [0.3,3], gamma=scale
rich_eeg_candidates: Original spectral logistic C=1; rich spectral/Hjorth/ratio logistic C=[0.03,0.3,1,3] and RBF SVC C=[0.3,3]; log-covariance PCA(5) logistic C=[0.3,3]. Clinical basic features remain available in every advanced candidate
rich_eeg_features: Same first 120 seconds of recorded provider-denoised signals for development participants only. Existing 20 log-relative band powers plus 5 regional sets of theta/alpha log ratio, slow/fast log ratio, normalized spectral entropy, Hjorth mobility and complexity. Four 0.5-4,4-8,8-13,13-30 Hz bands: fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth filtering, OAS shrinkage covariance, trace normalization, matrix logarithm, symmetric upper-triangle vectorization with sqrt(2) off-diagonal weights. Covariance represents second-order coupling, not causal connectivity. PCA is fitted on training patients only.
blend: alpha=clip(sum((y-pb)*(pa-pb))/sum((pa-pb)^2),0,1), learned from nested cross-fitted training probabilities. If denominator <=1e-12 alpha=0. Final advanced probability pb+alpha*(pa-pb). Empirical OOF minimization has no population-risk guarantee.
gates: Fixed ridge alpha=10 and ExtraTreesRegressor n_estimators=80,max_depth=3,min_samples_leaf=6,max_features=1.0. Inputs are imputed/scaled basic variables, basic probability and p*(1-p); targets are cross-fitted Brier improvement. Gate probabilities are out of fold during training. No gate hyperparameter tuning.
main_comparison: Nested blend nonlinear-gain versus uncertainty with identical tuned classifiers and capacity; rich representation for EEG, original features for other cohorts
secondary_comparisons: Learned blend versus raw advanced prediction, tuned versus fixed models, rich versus original EEG features; report every variant and every baseline, no winner selected post hoc
inference: Outer repeats are correlated and development participants were previously studied. Report paired repeat differences, mean and range descriptively, not confirmatory p values. No population superiority, external validation, prospective progression or neural-network claim.
stopping_rule: One fixed experiment matrix. Correct implementation errors with an audit entry; no outcome-driven expansion or retuning. Freeze final development-fitted bundles for a future independent cohort.
publication: Commit protocol before performance evaluation; publish code, source provenance, aggregate tables, figures and manuscript update. Exclude participant-level tables, recordings, predictions, bundles containing training IDs, credentials and local machine paths. Preserve earlier results.
